message: Vector Rebel 3.2.84: Dedicated BC Check button and quick rotating C-shift Captain Check, with saved direct PPE links.
releaseNotes: Master now has a prominent BC Check button. For the owner-linked C-shift pilot, Daily Captain Check opens the fast one-outstanding-item-per-working-firefighter rotating check rather than silently launching an all-item two-month audit. Full PPE History Audit is separate and explicitly optional; active read-only scans can be stopped from the BC board. During C-shift read-only checks, progress is labeled BC Check instead of Daily Captain. The first successful owner-scoped map saves validated same-origin native PPE detail paths to Rebel Command; subsequent rechecks navigate directly to the selected item for each confirmed-working firefighter, without repeated full crew inventory browsing. Dedicated monitoring pauses if direct links are missing rather than crawling repeatedly. No Vector administrator access, CrewSense writes, or inspection submissions.
